name: A whole save
about: A createPrompt payload to `ok` (201) or to the error: the status, the `code`, and where (`at`, and the UTF-16 `offset` for a reference). Every case is sent to a person whose library is empty and who holds `prompts.share` (a reader MAY delete what a case created). A string value written as {"$concat": [piece, ...]} is the pieces joined, a piece being a string or {"$repeat": text, "times": n}; a reader expands it before use. See docs/api/prompts-v1.md, The fields of a prompt.
